prompt: As of 2024, at the time of his birth, what was the middle name of the U.S. president who won Alaska, graduated from Yale University, and had a son named Michael?
answer: The president was **Gerald Ford**. He won Alaska in the 1976 election, graduated from Yale Law School, and had a son named Michael. At birth, he was named **Leslie Lynch King Jr.**, so his middle name was **Lynch**.
